translation.name: Yuusa chichame yaunchukia tura yamaram chichamjai aarmau

content: Wiakach aina chicharmau
Wiakach ainata, antuktarma. Atumka senchi waittsatin asarum, útkurum senchi chichaktarma.
Atumin waríri ainaka mesekartin ainawai. Tura atumi jaanchri pegker ainasha kaya yuam artinaiti.

Atumka oro, tura kuitcha nukap arutramainaig surimakrum chikich aina yaigchau ainarum nuna iwainturmak mesenawai. Tumainakai shuar ainaka atumin surimtairin nekainawai. Tura atumnaka Yuus waittan senchi suramuk jinum egkematin ainarme.
Antuktarma, shuar takau aina shir akikchamu asar, nukap shinuina nuna apu ashi senchirtin nayaimpinam puja nu antukuiti. Tuma asa Yuus atumnaka waittan suramsatnaiti.

Atumka shuar pegker ainaka ayamrumamainchau umarum waitkasrum maa jakuitrume. Tura ju nugka jui pujusrumka nukap shir ane jakuitrume. Vaca ni mantamnatnurin nekatsuk pujus, yutairin yua yuakua nuweru maam megkaina numamtuk, atumnasha Yuus waittanam utsanmak tuke emegkatmakartinaiti.
Jesucristo taatnuriya nuka waurtutsuk nakastarma timau

Yatsur, umaar ainata, Jesucristo taatnuriya nuka waurtutsuk nakastarma. Ju shir enentaimtusrum iistarma: Shuar arakan arakmauka yumi yutuk nugkan iminkati, turam árak ainasha shir tsapaimtai, nerencha nukap juukmij, tusar waurtutsuk nakau ainawai.
Atumsha numamtuk apu Jesucristo taatnurigka ashi jeawai tusarum, wakerusa nakamurmeka kajinmatkirpa.
Yatsur ainata, chikichnasha titajrume: Yuus waittanam utsanmakairum, chikich ainajaisha kajernaiyakrum aujmatnainirpa. Yuus taa, shuar pegker ainan tunau ainajai etegkratna nuka tsawan ashi jeawai.
Yatsur, umaar ainata, ju enentaimtusrum iistarma: Yaunchukka Yuusa chichamen etseru jakarua nuka senchi waitainaksha waurtutsuk pujusar, Yuusan chichamenka etseru jakaruiti.

Waitainaksha umamkesar pujusar, Yuus wakeramun taká jakarunka nitanka Yuus shir anentawai. Job pachisrumsha atumka antu jakuitrume. Nigka senchi waitaksha Yuusnak nekaspapita tu jakuiti. Tura Yuuska wait anenkartin asa, senchi yaigkuiti.
Waittanam weerum nekasa nuke chichaktarma timau

Wina yatsur ainata, Yuusa naariya nu anaikarum chichakrum: Wii nekas taja nu umiktinnaka Yuus iirkau atatui tusarmeka tiirpa. Nu tachakrumsha nugka pujuinaksha ashi chikich jumamtuk pachisa tumain ainaka tiirpa. Nekas pegker chichaakrumsha waitrutsuk, ayu titasrum wakerakrumka, ayu titarma, antsarmek atsaa titasrum wakerakrumsha, atsaa titarma, Yuus waittanam utsanmakairum.
Yuusjai chichaamu
Shuar iturchatnum pujak waitaka Yuusan aujmainaiti, antsu ni shir aneas pujauka kantamuk Yuusan emematmainaiti.

Atum ainarum nuiyatiram jakrumka, Jesucristonam surumankau aina nuna apuri untsuktarma. Ni tarutrama aceitejai yakarmak Yuusapi nekas shir amajsattawa tusa, shir aneas seatramkai pegker jastatrume, tura atum tunau takasmaurum arutramkaisha tsagkurnamainaitrume.
Nui atum ainatirmeka atumin tunauri ashi metek ujanaiktarma, tumakrum jakrumnasha Yuus pegker amajtamsarti tusarum Yuus seatnaitarma. Shuar tunaurinchau seamka Yuus yaimainaiti.

Ju enentaimsar iisarmi: Yuusa chichamen etserin Elías naartin, iya juninak ajakua nu, tres uwí nuiya seis nantu yumi yututsuk asati tusa, Yuus nekas turattawapi tusa seawaiti. Nu seamu asa ni timauka imanisag yumi yututsuk asauwaiti.
Iman uwí yumi yututsuk akai, ataksha Elías yumin yutumtikati, tusa Yuusan aujsauwaiti. Tura yutumtikamtai, árak ainasha neretan nagkama ainawai.
Wina yatsur ainata, shuar pegkernumag pujuwaitiat, Jesucriston inaiyakaigka, atum aina nuiyatiram antsuk shir pujusti tusa yaimainaiti.
Shuar tunaunak wekataun, chikich yaig awaigki pujut pegkernum awayaamtaigka, nu shuara tunauri nukap akaisha, Yuus ashi tsagkuur, waitat nagkanchaun jumain akaisha uwemtikratnaiti. Nu nekaatarma.
